title: Machine learning-guided composition gives heat-treatment-free high-strength ductile iron
summary: An ensemble learning model fit to orthogonal-experiment data guided composition optimization of ductile iron. The resulting as-cast alloy, produced with cored-wire spheroidization and triple inoculation, reached tensile strength 974 MPa, yield strength 613 MPa and elongation 6.2% without heat treatment, and industrial production is reported. Only the abstract was reviewed, so the ensemble algorithm and dataset size are not specified.
ai_technology: Ensemble learning on orthogonal-experiment data to model composition-property relations and optimize composition
organization: Qilu University of Technology; Shandong Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: The optimized alloy was cast and mechanically tested, with industrial production reported in the abstract.
evidence.unknown: Algorithm details, dataset size and cost or energy savings were not seen. Full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Modeled composition-property relationships to choose the alloy composition.
